name: apple-reminders
description: Add reminders to the native Apple Reminders app from Codex or ChatGPT

interface.shortDescription: Tell your AI. It’s on your list.
interface.longDescription: Apple Reminders gives Codex and ChatGPT one focused write action for creating native reminders on this Mac. Titles, dates, notes, lists, and priority are validated before Reminders is changed.
defaultPrompt: Remind me to submit my assignment tomorrow at 4 PM.
Add bring goggles to my School list.
Remind me next Friday to follow up.
